Latest QA Bug Summary — 27 August 2026

Environment: https://dev.panorra.com
Verdict: Bug confirmed — registration cannot be completed reliably.

Test Results

ID Method Scenario Expected result Actual result Status
TC-265-BB-001 Black Box Enter a one-character Full Name with the remaining form values valid Sign Up remains disabled or inline validation explains the minimum name requirement Sign Up becomes active; the backend rejects the submission with an alert Fail
TC-265-BB-002 Black Box Open Sign Up, initiate reCAPTCHA, close and reopen the registration flow CAPTCHA remains visible, actionable, and can be completed on every opening CAPTCHA challenge appears behind the registration popup; after reopening, it does not render again and blocks the flow Fail
TC-265-WB-001 White Box Review client form rules Client-side Full Name validation matches the backend acceptance rule fullname uses only Validators.required, so one character is valid in the UI Fail
TC-265-WB-002 White Box Review CAPTCHA render lifecycle CAPTCHA can mount again after the dialog is recreated captchaRendered stays true after a successful first render; the re-opened dialog returns before rendering a new widget Fail
TC-265-GB-001 Gray Box Submit valid-looking client form with one-character Full Name UI and API validation agree The UI enables submit, then the server rejects the request and surfaces an alert Fail

Confusion Matrix

Classification rule: the client determines whether the registration form is eligible for submission.

Actual input/state Expected client classification Observed result
One-character Full Name Invalid / reject False Positive — UI accepts the form state and enables Sign Up; server rejects it
Missing required field or CAPTCHA token Invalid / reject True Negative — Sign Up is blocked
Dialog reopened after CAPTCHA initialization CAPTCHA available False Negative for readiness — no usable CAPTCHA is rendered

Code Review

Area Source reference Finding
Full Name validation src/app/core/auth/signup/signup.component.ts The control has Validators.required only; it has no client minimum-length rule.
Submit eligibility src/app/core/auth/signup/signup.component.html Submit depends on form.invalid and the CAPTCHA token, therefore a one-character Full Name is eligible.
CAPTCHA lifecycle src/app/core/auth/signup/signup.component.ts captchaRendered prevents a subsequent grecaptcha.render() after the modal content is recreated.
CAPTCHA layering src/app/core/auth/signup/signup.component.html The widget is mounted inside the dialog content; runtime evidence shows the challenge is stacked behind the popup.

Evidence

Real-site recording supplied by QA: Sign Up validation and reCAPTCHA failure

Developer Action

  1. Align the Full Name client validator with the backend's minimum-length contract and show an inline validation message before enabling Sign Up.
  2. Reset/recreate the CAPTCHA widget when the registration dialog is reopened, and ensure the challenge layer is above the dialog/backdrop.

Latest QA Bug Summary — 27 August 2026

Environment: https://dev.panorra.com
Verdict: Blocked by confirmed Sign Up / CAPTCHA defect in Issue #265.

Test Results

ID Method Scenario Expected result Actual result Status
TC-670-BB-001 Black Box Register a new account and advance to OTP verification Registration opens the verification screen Registration cannot be completed reliably because the CAPTCHA is behind the popup and does not re-render after reopening Blocked
TC-670-WB-001 White Box Review OTP transition after registration Successful registration opens user OTP verification The transition is wired after registerAuth() success, but runtime entry is blocked upstream by the CAPTCHA defect Blocked
TC-670-GB-001 Gray Box Reach OTP API through the registration flow /users/check-otp is invoked with a user-entered code No OTP request was sent because no completed registration session could be created Blocked

Confusion Matrix

Classification rule: a newly registered user is eligible to enter OTP verification.

Actual state Expected classification Observed result
Completed registration Eligible for OTP verification Not observed — upstream CAPTCHA defect prevents completing registration
Registration with unavailable CAPTCHA Not eligible / must remain blocked True Negative — OTP route was not entered, but the upstream registration UX is defective

Code Review

Area Source reference Finding
OTP transition src/app/core/auth/signup/signup.component.ts A successful registration sets showPasswordVerification and showPasswordVerificationUser to true.
OTP verification src/app/core/auth/otp/otp.component.ts The entered code is sent through checkOTP(); a successful user-verification branch logs in the account.
OTP API mapping src/app/core/auth/auth.service.ts checkOTP() posts to /users/check-otp; resend posts to /users/resend-otp.

Evidence and Dependency

The upstream runtime failure is documented in Issue #265 and this QA recording: Sign Up validation and reCAPTCHA failure.

Developer Action

Fix and verify Issue #265 first. Then re-test registration-to-OTP, valid OTP, invalid OTP, and resend OTP on Dev.

[Authentication] 8. Logout — QA Test Plan and Feature Documentation

Issue type: QA-owned test plan and latest execution summary
GitHub issue: #671
Module: Authentication
Feature: Logout
Prepared by: QA (Quality Assurance) @ekosy9
Project: Panorra PWA

Feature Description

Authenticated users can end their Panorra PWA session from the user menu. The application removes user-specific client state, replaces the authenticated session with a viewer session, and returns to guest presentation.

Main Flow

Step User action Expected system behavior
1 Sign in with a valid account. The user menu and authenticated state are available.
2 Open the user menu and select Log Out. The application requests a viewer session and clears user-specific client state.
3 Reload completes. Guest presentation is shown; the authenticated user menu is no longer available.

Environment: https://dev.panorra.com
Result: Passed

TC-671-WB-001 White Box Review logout implementation User identity data is cleared and the session is demoted to a viewer session Source calls loginAuthViewer(), removes user identity storage, and reloads the page Pass
TC-671-BB-001 Black Box Log out from an authenticated user menu User data is removed and the app returns to guest presentation The authenticated user menu disappeared after Log Out; no user identity storage remained Pass
TC-671-GB-001 Gray Box Manual login before logout Valid tester session is established POST /auth?ec=true returned HTTP 200 Pass
TC-671-GB-002 Gray Box Logout session transition A viewer session replaces the authenticated session POST /auth/viewer?ec=true returned HTTP 200; viewer token remained as expected Pass
TC-671-UI-001 Black Box Manual-login form before authentication Submit remains unavailable when required fields are empty Submit was disabled Pass

Confusion Matrix

The classification decision is whether the browser is authenticated as a user or demoted to a guest/viewer session.

Actual state Expected classification Observed result
Valid tester credentials Authenticated user True Positive — HTTP 200 login response and authenticated menu visible
Logout action Guest/viewer session True Positive — HTTP 200 viewer response and user identity storage cleared
Invalid/missing required login data No authenticated session True Negative — manual-login submit disabled

Project: Panorra PWA

Feature Description

Users can log in to Panorra PWA with their email or username and password. Successful authentication establishes an authenticated session and continues to the account's next appropriate route. Invalid credentials must remain rejected.

Main Flow

Step User action Expected system behavior
1 Open dev.panorra.com and select Log in. The login options dialog is displayed.
2 Choose Log in with email. The manual login form shows email/username, password, password visibility toggle, forgot-password entry point, and Log In button.
3 Enter valid credentials and submit. The system authenticates the user and transitions to an authenticated route.
4 Enter invalid credentials and submit. The system rejects the request, keeps the user unauthenticated, and retains the login form.

Latest QA Summary — 27 August 2026

Result

The manual email/username login flow passed on the Dev site. A valid tester account returned HTTP 200 and transitioned from the guest login form to an authenticated route. Invalid credentials returned HTTP 400 and retained the login form; no authentication bypass was observed.
